centre.reprime_invitation: Today, the center you are working with is the Mental: thinking of yourself, seeing your own needs, planning for yourself. This is not selfishness — it is the soul returning to its own place.

dynamique_ego.passion_explication: Not a loud pride. A silent pride: 'I am the one who helps, who sees, who senses.' It disguises itself as generosity, but it maintains an asymmetry: I give, the other receives, never the reverse.
dynamique_ego.peur_de_base: Not being loved, being unwanted, being alone.

essence.qualite_phrase: You don't have to buy love — it is already there, waiting to be received.
horizons: Receiving without giving anything in return
Touching the connection that depends on no behavior

intentions_du_matin: Feel my own needs before those of others
Receive something, without giving anything back
Not anticipate anyone else's need today
Be alone with myself for fifteen minutes
Choose an activity for myself, that serves no one
Acknowledge help received, without returning it
pratiques_du_matin: Before noon, ask for a favor — small, concrete — without guilt.
Eat without checking who else is hungry.
When someone thanks you, receive the thanks without 'oh, it's nothing'.
One activity just for yourself, invisible to others.
When the reflex to help arises, check first: 'was I asked?'
Sit down and feel your body. Not to move — just to inhabit it.

zones.description: Free love. You give because it is right, not to obtain something. You receive without needing to compensate. Connection is nourishment, not ruin.
You help, you give — you feel pride creeping in sometimes but you see it. You manage your needs, in part.
You give in order to get, you accumulate resentment. Active codependency. Your own needs disappear into the fog.
Manipulation, victimhood, somatization. The body carries what the heart refuses to admit. A very heavy day that calls for help.

details_riso.texte: Unconditionally loving, generous with no agenda. Love comes and goes freely.
Empathetic, attuned to others AND to yourself. Nourishing giving, return possible.
Attentive to the needs of the world, able to love actively, an organizer of care.
Eager to please, sustained attention toward others. You begin to anticipate their needs.
Possessive, hidden agenda behind the giving. Emotional dependency rises.
Prideful, manipulative, hurt when you are not acknowledged.
Coercive, self-victimizing, whiny. You extort love.
Hysterical, somatization, despair. The body speaks what you won't admit.
Collapse, total dependency, pathological lying. Asking for help is vital here.

passions.label: I gave with a hidden agenda
I sought to be indispensable
passions.detail: So as not to be alone.

passions.label: I flattered to stay in the light
I smothered the other with care
I felt hurt at getting nothing back

pieges.label: I did not feel my own needs
I refused help that was offered
I erased myself for the sake of someone else
I half-cast myself as a victim

moments.label: I felt one of my needs, and honored it
I felt good, alone with myself
I helped without expecting anything in return
I gently said 'no', without justifying myself
I asked for something for myself
I felt a connection that depended on nothing
A love came and melted something in me

evenements_a_relire.label: I listened to my need for the first time

remedes.label: Humility — accepting that you have needs
Self first — so as to give truly
Boundaries — saying no out of love

matin: The morning begins. What do you need today?
A day opens — can you put your name on it?
What do you want to ask for today?
midi: You are in the middle of the day. Have you eaten for yourself?
Here you are. What need lives in you, right now?
A possible pause. What do you want to receive?
soir: The day is fading. Was something received, for you?
You can simply arrive, without giving anything.
The evening is gentle. A request, if it comes.
nuit: The night watches. One single thing for you, then sleep.
You are still here. That is already a great deal.
